result.headline: Outputs ch[4] and ch[5] each froze at neutral mid-flight, ch[4] first, with no event or tracking loss
result.explanation: Two paired actuator outputs stopped following their command and held 1500 us, ch[4] first and ch[5] later. The recording shows no mode change or event explaining it and no attitude tracking loss. The cause is not identified.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[4]] held 1500 from t=105.28 to 176.142 s (208 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[4] output froze, then resumed varying.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[5]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=176.442 s to the end of the recording (56.607 s, 167 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[5] froze at 176.442 s and stayed frozen to the end, while ch[4] varied again.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=105.28 s: actuator.output[ch[4]] was moving, then held 1500 for 70.862 s (see line 25; strength 4.641)
evidence.shows: The first freeze follows a hard manoeuvre: roll setpoint 44.77 deg and ch[4] and ch[5] at 1450 at 101.799 s.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.velocity[y] changed level for good at t=30.798 s: median 18.59 before, -0.37 after m/s (7.3x its variation before)
evidence.shows: A heading turn: yaw median 87.893 to 182.236 deg while velocity[x] went from -0.24 to -18.895 m/s. Not a fault.

checked.result: Only ch[4] (105.28 s) and ch[5] (176.442 s) froze. Roll and pitch tracking error ratios were 1.49 and 1.63 at 105.28 s, and 1.07 and 0.87 at 176.442 s.
checked.about: Output-channel freeze without visible loss of attitude control

checked.check: Relation ch[4] vs ch[5], 0.232 to 104.964 s
checked.result: Correlation 1.0, best lag 0.0 s, typical difference 0.0 us. They carry the same command.
checked.about: Both freezes hit the same pair of outputs

checked.check: Windows with ch[4] frozen, then ch[5] frozen
checked.result: Roll and pitch still follow their setpoints, e.g. roll setpoint 44.77 vs measured 36.967 at 170.26 s. No sustained divergence.
velocity[y] median 18.68 to 0.135 and velocity[x] -0.24 to -18.895 m/s while yaw went 87.893 to 182.236 deg: a turn.
Only start-up warnings at 0.883 s. No failsafe or mode event near either freeze. No earlier cases.

effects.why: After ch[4] resumed it varies while ch[5] is stuck, so the pair no longer matches. A consequence of the freezes.
